name: Drive & Kick
idea: Dribble hard to the basket, then pass out to the teammate who gets left open.
why: When a defender leaves their player to help stop the drive, the player they were guarding is suddenly open.
tryit: Drive with your eyes up! Look for the teammate whose defender just left them.

frames.say: {3} is way out in the corner. Watch what happens when {1} attacks!
*Drive:* {1} dribbles hard toward the basket and zooms past {X1}.
{X3} leaves the corner to stop {1}. Now {3} is all alone!
*Kick:* {1} passes out to {3} in the corner.
Corner three! Drive in, pass out. That’s a Drive & Kick.
